entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 175 of 2022
Petitioner :- Smt. Shakuntala Devi And 5 Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Saurabh Kumar,Sudhir Kumar Agarwal

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Santosh Kumar Yadav,Shyam Mohan Singh
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1.
No one present on behalf of the respondent No.3/informant.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
3.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 19.12.2021, registered as Case Crime No.710 of 2021, under Sections- 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Mau Aima, District-Prayagraj, and for a Smt. Shakuntala Devi And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40453202/
1 direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.
4. It appears to be matrimonial dispute between the parties.

entities.text: Shakuntala Devi And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Efforts of mediation has already failed.

5. Petition is disposed of directing that till cognizance is taken on police report under Section 173(2)
Cr.P.C., by the court the respondents shall not arrest the petitioners pursuant to the First Information Report dated 19.12.2021, registered as Case Crime No.710 of 2021, under Sections- 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Mau Aima, District-Prayagraj, subject to cooperation in ongoing investigation.
Order Date :- 12.4.2024

Amit (Surendra Singh-I,J.) (Siddharth,J.)
